contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop and cafe windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: No hand-held prop; the cafe table and street are the setting. The vest closes with two chest buckles and has no zip. The hands cover part of the upper buckle, and the vest back is inferred. The royal blue long sleeve is a separate product beneath the vest straps. The watch is a silver round case with a dark face on a metal bracelet; its hidden links are inferred. The gray shorts and black tights are separate products. Brand, metal, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 검정 베스트 아래 로열블루 긴소매의 반사띠.

intro.ko: 달리기를 멈추고 가슴끈을 양손으로 다시 맞춥니다.

body.ko: 지퍼 없는 검정 하이드레이션 베스트는 두 가로 버클로 닫힙니다. 별도 로열블루 긴소매의 흰 위팔 띠는 플래시를 받고, 밝은 회색 쇼츠와 검정 긴 타이츠가 하체를 나눕니다. 검정 러닝화의 흰 창과 은색 금속 밴드 스포츠워치가 어두운 면 안에 밝은 끝점을 남깁니다.
body.en: The zip-free black hydration vest closes with two horizontal buckles. White upper-arm bands on the separate royal blue long-sleeve top catch flash above light gray shorts and black full tights. White shoe soles and a silver-tone metal-bracelet sports watch add pale endpoints within dark layers.
body.de: Die schwarze Trinkweste ohne Zip schließt mit zwei waagerechten Schnallen. Weiße Oberarmbänder des separaten königsblauen Langarmshirts fangen Blitz über hellgrauen Shorts und schwarzer langer Tight. Weiße Schuhsohlen und eine silberfarbene Sportuhr mit Metallband setzen helle Endpunkte.

pull.en: Blue sleeves remain separate beneath the straps.
pull.de: Blaue Ärmel bleiben unter den Gurten eigenständig.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Blue sleeves remain separate beneath the straps.

tip.ko: 두 버클을 따로 조절하고 상의가 끈 아래 접히지 않았는지 확인하세요.
tip.en: Adjust each buckle separately and check the top is not folded beneath the straps.
tip.de: Jede Schnalle einzeln einstellen und das Shirt unter den Gurten glatt halten.
